access.authentication: Official Ethereum RPC page documents https://rpc.ankr.com/eth for direct use; public endpoint requires no email signup or personal information.
access.cost: Official Service Plans list Public plan as free, no contract; this route uses no key, account, Freemium or Premium access.
access.terms_scope: Ankr Terms effective 2026-07-15 grant royalty-free use solely for the customer's own internal business purposes and restrict third-party access and commercial exploitation without prior written consent. This route is for internal research only; do not expose the service or redistribute Ankr service content.
access.anonymous_probe: Two eth_blockNumber probes were issued while capturing the result. The first response was not serialized; the second returned HTTP 200 with JSON-RPC -32000 Unauthorized requiring an API key. No credential was used and eth_getLogs was not called. No further requests are permitted under the current unavailable status.

route.task: bounded Ethereum ERC-20 Transfer logs for one exact token contract
route.block_range: Inclusive, at most 1,000 blocks; Public plan documented maximum.
route.provider_response_limit: Ankr documents up to 200,000 logs per eth_getLogs response; client response body limit is 2,000,000 bytes.
route.credentials: None; never add or infer API credentials.
route.cache: None. Each invocation is a bounded fresh read.
route.readiness: Fixture-tested implementation, but the exact official no-signup endpoint returned JSON-RPC Unauthorized and required an API key. Contract gate blocks all live requests until Ankr documents or demonstrates zero-charge anonymous access again; do not register, add a key, or retry.

evidence.upstream_lineage: Ankr public Ethereum RPC backed by globally distributed nodes; the exact serving node/operator is not disclosed per response.
evidence.observation_timestamp: eth_getLogs does not include block timestamps; outputs explicitly retain null timestamps.
evidence.units: Transfer data is raw uint256 token base units. Decimals, USD valuation and net flows are not inferred.
evidence.coverage: Bounded block-range response only. Empty logs do not prove zero transfers or completeness; log coverage and reorganization finality are not attested.
evidence.independence: UNKNOWN; do not treat as independent corroboration of other RPCs/indexers without per-observation lineage.

failure_policy.authentication_payment_forbidden_rate_li: Stop this provider branch; no retry or fallback.
failure_policy.malformed_identity_mismatch_response_too: Reject response; no retry or fallback.

prohibited: API keys, signup, Freemium, Premium, or paid routes
commercial exploitation or third-party service access absent prior written consent
claims of complete history, UTC event time, USD value, net flow, or zero transfers without additional evidence
